subject.title: fix: require decimal numeric oc-path predicates

question: Should oc-path intentionally break its documented finite-number coercion contract by rejecting exponent and hexadecimal predicate strings, or should this fix only exclude blank and whitespace-only operands?
rationale: Both implementations are technically possible, but choosing a stricter shipped CLI grammar is a compatibility and product-policy decision that the contributor cannot safely infer.

options.title: Preserve documented coercion
options.body: Keep exponent and hexadecimal finite-number inputs working while rejecting only blank or whitespace-only operands and adding focused regression coverage.

options.title: Adopt strict decimal grammar
options.body: Approve the compatibility break explicitly, update the public CLI documentation, and prove both fresh and upgrade behavior before merge.

recommendation.title: Preserve documented coercion
recommendation.body: Keep exponent and hexadecimal finite-number inputs working while rejecting only blank or whitespace-only operands and adding focused regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent oc-path parser history and release integration make this person the strongest available owner for the public grammar decision.
